description: Pittston, PA — Rob for PA today released two new TV ads, “Produce” and “Archbald,” highlighting Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s work in Congress to lower costs, support Northeastern Pennsylvania’s farmers, and keep decisions about local communities in local hands.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s Campaign Releases Two New TV Ads: “Produce” and “Archbald” - Rob for PA
